EvidenceBody: The records make it public-interview vocabulary: Dongshan is asked about 'oneself before the empty eon,' asks who lives in the empty-eon house with no people, and later collections ask about the affair before the empty eon. Verses call its road broad and idle or say that nobody knows the far-off empty eon. A discourse itself expands the phrase as 'before heaven and earth were divided.' It is a stock Chan time-beyond-cosmic-time formula.
